messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] sev1 - runtime-engine container crashloop (SIGSEGV) on pool gpu-us-east-3 / node gpu-node-14. 120+ restarts in 10m. Impact: increased 5xx for gen endpoints. Paging on-call. https://ops.redwood/incident/1739001234

alex: got the alert, jumpin. seeing crashloop on runtime-engine:v2.4. core dump shows SIGSEGV in fused_kernel.so +0x1f24

jamal: confirmed. reproducing locally with same model (redwood/gptx-13b-quant). stacktrace points to tensorrt fused attention kernel: illegal memory access / cudaErrorIllegalAddress

mira: any node-level OOMs? gpu memory usage spiked right before crash?

alex: docker stats on node: GPU mem at ~98% then immediate segfault. nvcrash shows "IllegalAddress" and GPU reset. Kernel logs attached: 
```
[ 1234.567890] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3:00): 15, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[ 1234.570000] kernel: out of memory: kill process 8421 (runtime-engine)
[ 1234.575000] runtime-engine[8421]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f6a12ab1f24 sp 00007ffc1c2a3f80 error 4 in fused_kernel.so[7f6a12900000+120000]
```

jamal: looks like fused kernel triggers an illegal mem access when running attention with sequence_len ~2048 and batch mixing. Possibly a race in kv-cache handling. Not purely OOM; GPU reset follows illegal address error.

sre_pager: customer-eng reports increased 5xx for three customers (alpha-app, docs-search, chat-prody). Alpha-app traffic is high; fallback traffic routing not engaged.

mira: quick mitigation: scale down that model variant, route traffic to smaller model variant (gptx-13b-quant-safemode) and enable cache-bypass to avoid fused kernel path. Can we flip routing in the router?

alex: yes. issuing: `redwood router set-route --service runtime-gen --variant gptx-13b-quant-safemode --weight 100`

jamal: also cordon gpu-node-14 and drain gracefully to stop further crashloops and preserve core dumps: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-14 && kubectl drain gpu-node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

incident-bot: action recorded: routing change + node cordon requested.

mira: on-call to confirm runbook step 3 (hotpatch qemu/driver?) — i think we should avoid kernel-level hotpatch; prefer container image rollback to previous runtime-engine:v2.3 which uses a non-fused kernel.

alex: starting rollout: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime-engine runtime-engine=redwood/runtime-engine:v2.3 --namespace=prod` then monitoring.

customer-eng: notifying impacted customers: alpha-app (SLA 99.9) may see degraded throughput. Sending templated message.

jamal: digging into logs: captured last 3 traces. here's minimal repro snippet (using vllm harness):
```
python repro.py --model redwood/gptx-13b-quant --seq 2048 --batch "[12,3,1]"
# crashes with: cuda illegal memory access at attention_compile::launch
```

mira: good repro. please attach to bug with core + backtrace. Create issue in infra/runtime with `priority:sev1` and label `fused-kernel` + `tensorrt`.

jamal: created issue #INF-4821. uploaded core + .pt reproducer + perf traces. assigned to @jamal and @ryan-ml.

alex: monitoring metrics — 5xx rate for runtime-gen dropped from 18% to 2% after routing flip. CPU and GPU error counts on node stopped increasing after cordon. :thumbsup:

mira: handoff - I need to step out. Jamal take lead for driver/kernel debug and hotfix. I'll stay on async for customer comms. Jamal you're primary on-call for next 2h?

jamal: taking over. timestamp handoff 1739001260. I'll keep the channel updated and escalate to ML runtime team if we can't reproduce with patched image.

incident-bot: oncall-handoff recorded: previous_oncall=mira next_oncall=jamal at 1739001260

alex: planned next steps: 1) keep safemode variant for traffic for 1h and monitor errors. 2) run CI with valgrind-like checks in fused kernel harness. 3) prepare runtime-engine:v2.4.1 with bounds-checking in attention kernel. 4) schedule controlled canary for v2.4.1 after verification.

customer-eng: customers notified: alpha-app updated 12:38 UTC, docs-search updated 12:42 UTC, chat-prody updated 12:45 UTC. No escalations yet.

jamal: last update: kernel oops looks deterministic with seq>=1600 when using mixed-batch kv cache. I'm attaching a short patch to avoid the fused path for mixed batch until we have a proper fix. Deploying quick patch build `runtime-engine:hotfix-173900` to canary nodes now.

mira: ack. keep me posted. I'll update post-incident notes and do P0 blameless review tomorrow.

alex: thanks all — closing pager as mitigated once hotfix canary stable and error rate <1% for 15min.

sre_pager: monitoring window started. next check 1739001399.
